method: Desktop 1440x900 and phone390x844 initial screenshots viewed before any author ART.md, historical reviewer reports or other art critics. No benchmark seen yet.
01: White open almanac: large serif week headline below generous navigation; spread-like score and margin note. Phone has collapsed contents then single-column matchup with roomy scores.
02: Cobalt court occupies left three fifths; positions link to a pale field-notes panel. Phone retains an actual court map as first screen, with notes below.
03: Navy sequential dossier: matchup left, saved decisions as tall pale right sheet; fixed chapter strip across bottom. Phone stacks dark matchup above pale sheet with select/arrow chapter navigation.
04: Broadcast control room: black left source rail, central program, narrow scores right; blue slugs and red selection. Phone source select plus compact score strip, then central program.
05: Fluorescent yellow typographic fact field; very large free-positioned score, price, percentage and headline. Phone keeps staggered fact composition, not a card feed.
06: Pale green chronological league wire: side team brief, central dated spine and event records. Phone places team brief before the dated feed and retains filters.
07: Warm illustrated clubhouse wall: charcoal scoreboard next to searchable brown lockers containing portraits. Phone puts scoreboard before locker room; jump controls visible.
08: Dark mirrored comparison: gold home and blue opponent with central measure spine, headshots below, view tabs. Phone keeps two score columns then chooses a side for deeper reading.
09: Light blue branch notebook: open parallel evidence branches with hairline tree stems and monospaced numeric facts. Phone stacks branches with prominent branch index.
10: Dark green player quote list left, pale retained two-package evidence tray right. Phone opens directly into trade packages; editing tray has a fixed bottom summary.
11: Lavender search-first directory: broad search line, category tabs, clean action-result rows. Phone narrows the same search workflow without duplicating a dashboard hero.
12: Dark constellation with peripheral team faces over home/away cards and a central connection spine. Phone initially places matchup connection ahead of team cards; comparison pin remains offered.
13: Navy/gold hinged folio with progress banner, current score sheet and navy pick flap, fold/next controls. Phone retains book controls then score sheet above picks.
14: Four adjacent vertical channels, lime member rail, white league, pale scout and dark culture, each with dense linking context. Phone begins lime team channel and exposes four channel controls.
15: Ice-blue week planner with date columns and evidence rows. Phone defaults to agenda with calendar toggle and date selector.
17: White ledger, tiny monospaced tabular detail, club/record/opponent/value columns, search/order and sheets. Phone becomes readable row dossiers with selectable fields.
20: Plum branching intent tree, compact current-match context on the left and large question with five paths on the right. Phone keeps small fixture context then the tree question and choices.
16: Dark green personal canvas with broad matchup+arena region, adjacent large franchise portraits, Arrange and Add league material. Phone preserves the kept-item order but displays one width, with arena preceding current score.
19: Navy franchise yearbook: enormous cream condensed title and club names, gold standing numerals, alphabet/search/order above full-width franchise entries with player cutouts. Phone retains a compact yearbook title, visible current-pairing sentence, search/initial/order, and each club entry above bottom team/find/notebook/my-team navigation.
18: Cream evidence comparison matrix, dark teal measure/source headers, peach and lavender player columns, pin control and player/team mode tabs. Phone deliberately pivots into field-first records under pinned-player names, preserving each measure and period instead of shrinking a table.
